news.title: Shares Jump on Vaccine Policy Lawsuit
news.text: Moderna stock gained 8.8% after medical organizations sued over U.S. COVID-19 vaccine policies, raising hopes for supportive policy changes.

news.title: Cancer Research Funding Risks Highlighted
news.text: The Guardian warned that political scrutiny of mRNA vaccines could threaten funding for Moderna's cancer research initiatives.

news.title: FDA Debate Surfaces Around Latest Approval
news.text: BioPharma Dive reported that Moderna's newest vaccine approval exposed divisions within the FDA over mRNA policy.

news.title: Moderna Plans 10% Workforce Reduction
news.text: Moderna announced layoffs affecting 10% of employees to cut costs amid declining COVID-19 vaccine sales.

news.title: Blackstone Commits Up to $750M for Flu Program
news.text: Moderna secured up to $750 million in financing from Blackstone Life Sciences to advance its flu vaccine pipeline.

news.title: Second-Quarter Results Beat Expectations
news.text: Moderna delivered roughly $3.2 billion in Q2 revenue and exceeded EPS forecasts while reiterating $6 billion COVID-19 vaccine sales guidance.

news.title: Analysts Raise Targets Following Earnings
news.text: Truist Securities maintained a Hold rating but lifted its price target from $130 to $150 after reviewing Moderna's cost controls and pipeline updates.

news.title: BARDA Collaboration Announced
news.text: Moderna partnered with BARDA to develop a next-generation mRNA vaccine capable of protecting against multiple respiratory viruses.

news.title: Manufacturing and R&D Hub Opens in UK
news.text: Moderna inaugurated a state-of-the-art UK facility to expand global R&D and manufacturing capacity.

news.title: CEO Highlights Strategy at Morgan Stanley Conference
news.text: CEO Stéphane Bancel outlined priorities in respiratory vaccines, oncology, and international expansion during Morgan Stanley's healthcare conference.

news.title: Guidance Cut Triggers Share Decline
news.text: Reuters reported that Moderna delayed its break-even target by two years and lowered 2025 sales projections, prompting a 17% stock drop.

news.title: Vaccine Safety Scrutiny Intensifies
news.text: News coverage highlighted renewed scrutiny of COVID-19 vaccine safety claims, with Moderna reaffirming its safety record.

news.title: Positive Phase 3 Data for Personalized Cancer Vaccine
news.text: Moderna reported that its PCV with Merck's Keytruda reduced melanoma mortality risk, marking a breakthrough for its oncology pipeline.

news.title: Analysts Boost Ratings After Cancer Vaccine Update
news.text: Firms including Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and Jefferies raised ratings or targets following Moderna's positive cancer vaccine results.

news.title: Q3 2025 Earnings Release Date Set
news.text: Moderna scheduled its third-quarter 2025 earnings release for November 6.

news.title: Partnership Talks on Cancer Vaccine Reported
news.text: Reports indicated Moderna was negotiating with a major pharmaceutical partner regarding commercialization of its cancer vaccine technology.
